title: docs(skills): an agent's model name and provider are optional

_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSVqcTHLLFPjviMwGsR87vDC)_

epic:#5055#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPtiBXJZAqMqBPe3UD

Fixes #37711

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The `objectstack-ai` skill still taught that an agent names its model and that `provider` defaults to `openai`. Since #37697 (merge `3e87d7b6`) both are optional and `provider` has no default. This PR brings the published text and its eval in line.

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, Model Configuration:
  - `model` is an optional free-string name; absent means the host's default model for the environment.
  - `provider` is optional with no default (the deployment's choice, see #37712). The inline enum list is unchanged and still accurate: `openai | azure_openai | anthropic | local`.
  - The schema citation moves from the stale `agent.zod.ts:36-40` to `:37-45`, the `AIModelConfigSchema` key list on main.
- `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, case 2: accepts an omitted `model` and states the provider has no default. Assertions unchanged.
- One `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset.

No tier or sentinel wording (phase 2, not in the framework).

## Premise (on `origin/main` `cbc353ed`)

`packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts`:

```ts
37  provider: z.enum(['openai', 'azure_openai', 'anthropic', 'local']).optional(),
38  model: z.string().optional().describe(
39    'Model name (e.g. gpt-4, claude-3-opus). Optional: when absent, the agent runs on the '
40    + 'host\'s default model for this environment, so an agent that only tunes sampling '
41    + '(e.g. `temperature`) need not name a model.',
42  ),
43  temperature: z.number().min(0).max(2).default(0.7),
44  maxTokens: z.number().optional(),
45  topP: z.number().optional(),
```
